milestones.title: October audit: safer operations and more reliable diagnostics
features: JWT signatures and expiration are required. Role matching and deployment-mode permissions cover REST and WebSocket operations; workspace resource isolation remains unfinished.
Failed writes preserve live state; migration settings, optimistic versions, missing JDBC configuration and CRD resource-name collisions are handled explicitly.
Registry caches are isolated, remote errors remain visible, binary Avro round-trips correctly, replay failures surface, and bridge delivery preserves provenance headers.

MCP handles backend lag and DLQ responses correctly, reports failed checks and returns UNKNOWN for incomplete clean assessments. DLQ counts are samples, not queue depth. The console reports partial redrive and absent lag data.
Published version claims now follow verified release metadata. Unimplemented Redis distribution is rejected rather than appearing to provide cross-pod delivery.

milestones.title: Identity, workspace and cluster foundations; incident triage preview
features: Development implementation validates shared-secret JWTs and extracts identity claims. OIDC discovery, JWKS and enterprise sign-in are not implemented.
In-memory workspace metadata and a browser selector. Connections, bridges and streams are not isolated by workspace; this is not a tenant security boundary.
Local fan-out and node status are implemented. Redis mode is rejected at startup because its transport and shared subscription registry are unfinished.
A compound diagnostic tool and prompt collect broker, lag and DLQ information using fixed heuristics. This preview offers investigation hints, not autonomous remediation.

milestones.title: Replication routing and connection feedback
features: Corrected replication routing and error handling, improved the empty-connection experience, and added schema and replay guides.

milestones.title: Connect systems. Keep connection state.
features: Route messages between brokers with filtering, header transformations, loop prevention, and a dry-run tester.

File and JDBC stores plus a CRD-shaped resource-file store, with migration controls. The CRD implementation does not watch the Kubernetes API. Shared connection persistence does not distribute live subscriptions.

milestones.title: Understand the event, its context, and its backlog.
features: Visualize Kafka partition lag, skew, broker topology, and partition distribution.
Follow W3C trace context and open configured tracing-system links from message details.
Redact configured sensitive fields and inspect sample masking output. Masking is not a per-user authorization boundary.

milestones.title: Investigate failures and work with structured messages.
features: Introduced time-travel replay and offset-rewind workflows for supported operations.
Inspect failed messages and republish selected messages or a bounded batch. Redrive does not remove source messages or provide a rate limiter.
Publishing templates and pre-flight schema validation.
Registry integration and Avro decoding for message inspection.

milestones.title: Stronger feedback before shipping.
features: Added browser flows against a running backend and bounded Kafka connection validation.
CI checks generated frontend types against the backend API contracts.

roadmap.title: Per-connection rate limiting
roadmap.description: Bound publish, search, and subscription traffic per connection. Payload-size and concurrent-subscription limits already exist; request-rate controls are a separate backlog item.

roadmap.title: Deeper MQTT and JMS inspection
roadmap.description: Explore richer queue and retained-message inspection while respecting each brokerâ€™s semantics and avoiding destructive reads.

roadmap.title: Enterprise identity
roadmap.description: Shared-secret JWT authentication and operation-level role enforcement exist in unreleased development. OIDC discovery, JWKS and enterprise sign-in remain unfinished; workspace metadata does not provide tenant isolation.

roadmap.title: Distributed subscription state
roadmap.description: Shared subscription routing and cross-pod delivery remain open architecture work. PVCs and sticky sessions alone do not provide full active-active operation.

roadmap.title: Live cloud-broker CI coverage
roadmap.description: Cloud SDK paths currently use mocked tests. Broader live cloud validation depends on service parity, credentials, and an approved CI budget.
